prompts.prompt:
Create a polished high-fidelity UI design mockup for the SAME independent Android TV application "Twitch 2.0". One entire 16:9 screen, front-on, edge-to-edge, ideally 1920x1080 or higher; NO television hardware, perspective, desk, browser chrome, explanatory annotations or presentation frame. This is a visual proposal, not an actual app screenshot. Shared design system: matte almost-black #0d0e12 canvas, charcoal #191b23 panels, quiet borders #30323e, warm white #f2f1f6 primary text, gray #a4a6b5 secondary text, restrained soft lavender #c0a3ff for keyboard/D-pad focus, red #f45b70 solely for live status, subdued gray for offline. Modern humanist sans-serif with accurate, extremely readable Russian Cyrillic labels, generous TV-sized type and safe margins. Premium clear hierarchy, compact media-first composition, subtle 10px corner radii, consistent simple outlined icons, no glassmorphism, excessive bloom, floating decorative dots, marketing headings or prose. Focus is immediately obvious; only ONE focused actionable element. Unfocused selected nav item is subtle. Clock "21:40" at top right. No instructional footer. All media is fictional demo content. The screen should feel intentionally designed, calm and usable from a sofa. SCREEN: CATALOG. Left sidebar occupying 15% of width, separated by quiet thin line. Top standalone magnifying-glass icon and label "Поиск"; beneath it icon rows "Каналы", "Записи", "Категории", "Рекомендации", the latter subtly selected. Lower in sidebar a personal channel list, with small illustrated circular avatars and names: "Pixel", "Nova", "Tank" with tiny RED status dots touching each avatar bottom-right, then "Luna", "Orbit" with GRAY status dots. Online rows above offline rows, offline names slightly muted but readable. No "В эфире" heading, no solitary red dot floating above the list. Bottom sidebar ONLY gear icon and "Настройки", no account/about row.
Main area title "Рекомендации", clock top right, no huge hero banner. A crisp three-column, two-row grid of SIX landscape video cards; all fully visible with well-spaced metadata. Thumbnails richly varied: sunlit fantasy adventure landscape, racing cockpit at dusk, cozy creator studio, stylized tank game, colorful tactical game, music studio. On EVERY live thumbnail the ONLY red live dot is INSIDE a small dark badge at BOTTOM LEFT, immediately beside the audience number: "12,4 тыс.", "8,2 тыс.", "2,1 тыс.", "964", "720", "438". No red dot at upper left and no word LIVE. Beneath each thumbnail concise large channel name (Pixel, Nova, Mira, Tank, Orbit, Luna), one short Russian stream title, then smaller game/category. First card Pixel focused with elegant lavender perimeter and tiny enlargement that does NOT overlap neighbors. Focused thumbnail shows gameplay and small creator face camera. Metadata outside image remains legible. Sidebar and card grid share baseline rhythm. No badges that resemble nonfunctional buttons.
